purpose: Autonomous Round-1 research only. No Production writes and no human approval states.

foundation_jobs.title: Complete URL/Entity Inventory
foundation_jobs.instructions: Build the most complete SEO-relevant URL/entity inventory possible from live sitemaps/crawlable navigation, WordPress/Woo read-only evidence when safely available, raw GSC exports, and existing repository knowledge. Include canonical content entities plus URL-space representatives/policies for machine-generated spaces. Do not collect customer/order data.

foundation_jobs.title: Map page types, taxonomies and CPTs
foundation_jobs.instructions: Map all current WordPress/Woo page types, product types, taxonomies, archives and custom post types; reconcile them against inventory and identify missing families. Explicitly inventory Product Tags and Blog Tags, their assignments, public archive URL patterns and counts. These two tag systems are planned for controlled decommission; do not remove them in Round 1.

foundation_jobs.title: Map legacy URLs
foundation_jobs.instructions: Map legacy URLs using GSC historical pages, current redirects/canonicals and safe read-only evidence. Preserve entity identity and explicitly record unproven mappings.

foundation_jobs.title: Sitewide Technical SEO Baseline
foundation_jobs.instructions: Execute docs/SITEWIDE-TECHNICAL-AUDIT-SPEC.md read-only: crawl/index controls, sitemaps, redirects/errors, canonical/duplicate URL spaces, facets, JS/AJAX discoverability, internal links, structured data, Woo architecture, images, performance/mobile evidence and crawler access. Create initial systemic findings when evidence supports them. Treat Product Tag and Blog Tag archive spaces as explicit decommission candidates: collect current crawl/index/sitemap/canonical/internal-link behavior and migration risks, but make no Production changes.

foundation_jobs.title: Rank Math Configuration & Ownership Audit
foundation_jobs.instructions: Verify installed Rank Math edition/version/modules and current ownership for titles/meta/robots/canonical/sitemaps/schema/Woo/redirections/robots.txt plus relevant custom hooks. Use safe read-only server evidence or a sanitized setup snapshot. Do not expose secrets.

foundation_jobs.title: Detect duplicate SEO owners/output
foundation_jobs.instructions: Find duplicate/conflicting generators for title/meta/canonical/robots/schema/sitemap/redirect behavior across Rank Math, theme, plugins and custom code/output. Record owner_before and recommended target owner without implementing.

foundation_jobs.title: Normalize Search Console baseline
foundation_jobs.instructions: Create reproducible derived summaries from immutable GSC exports. Preserve source/date/dimensions and do not mutate raw files. Do not create false Page+Query joins.

foundation_jobs.title: Obtain or document Page+Query evidence
foundation_jobs.instructions: Determine whether joined Page+Query evidence is available. If available, store only safe derived SEO data with provenance. If unavailable, document exact limitation and acceptable alternatives; do not fabricate a join.

foundation_jobs.title: Initial Query/Intent Map
foundation_jobs.instructions: Build the initial evidence-backed query/intent map from GSC and current site architecture. Clearly mark hypotheses where page-query attribution is not proven.

foundation_jobs.title: Initial Content Architecture
foundation_jobs.instructions: Build initial content architecture: families, hubs/support relationships, product↔education opportunities, overlap/cannibalization hypotheses and gaps. No final rewrite decisions. For the planned Product Tag and Blog Tag decommission, identify durable replacement navigation/landing destinations (categories, shop, articles or hubs) so tag removal does not create content or internal-link gaps.

foundation_jobs.title: Bootstrap Systemic Findings Registry
foundation_jobs.instructions: Consolidate evidence-backed FAMILY/SITEWIDE findings from A-010..A-019 into the registry, deduplicate them, preserve evidence classes/confidence and add initial recommendations only.

foundation_jobs.title: Freeze Pilot Batch 001 selection
foundation_jobs.instructions: Select five representative Store/Woo entities for the first audit batch using GSC opportunity plus family/edge-case diversity. Selection is for audit sequencing only; do not approve changes.
